Salaries and other provisions totaled more than a million, field officials numbered in the hundreds, and each year the best were promoted for transfer. Three thousand separate households were set aside to serve the prefect's attendants.
translations.idiomatic: At first the prefecture had garrison fields. The chief minister held the commission remotely, while the prefect could report directly. Salaries and other provisions totaled more than a million, field officials numbered in the hundreds, and each year the best were promoted for transfer. Three thousand separate households were set aside to serve the prefect's attendants.

sentences.zh: 玨至，悉條去之，租入贏異時。

translations.literal: When Jue arrived, he listed and removed all of these. Rental income exceeded that of former times.
translations.idiomatic: When Jue arrived, he listed and removed all of these. Rental income exceeded that of former times.

sentences.zh: 觀察使惡其絜，誣以罪，左授峽州刺史。

translations.literal: The observation commissioner resented his purity and falsely charged him with a crime, demoting him to prefect of Xia Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The observation commissioner resented his integrity and falsely charged him with a crime, demoting him to prefect of Xia Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 建中初，德宗命使者分諸道察官吏升黜焉，而李承狀玨之簡，趙贊言其廉，盧翰稱其肅，書參聞，於是拜中散大夫，賜金紫。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Jianzhong, Emperor Dezong ordered envoys to inspect officials throughout the circuits for promotion and demotion. Li Cheng reported on Jue's simplicity, Zhao Zan spoke of his incorruptibility, and Lu Han praised his solemnity. When the reports reached the throne, Jue was appointed Grand Master of Palace Leisure and granted the gold seal and purple robe.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Jianzhong reign, Emperor Dezong ordered envoys to inspect officials throughout the circuits for promotion and demotion. Li Cheng reported on Jue's simplicity, Zhao Zan spoke of his incorruptibility, and Lu Han praised his solemnity. When the reports reached the throne, Jue was appointed Grand Master of Palace Leisure and granted the gold seal and purple robe.

sentences.zh: 劉玄佐表兼汴宋行軍司馬。

translations.literal: Liu Xuanzuo memorialized that he concurrently serve as Acting Army Vice Commander of Bian and Song.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Xuanzuo memorialized that he concurrently serve as Acting Army Vice Commander of Bian and Song.

sentences.zh: 李希烈棄汴州走，即拜玨刺史，遷河南尹。

translations.literal: When Li Xilie abandoned Bian Prefecture and fled, Jue was at once appointed prefect and then transferred to Governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Xilie abandoned Bian Prefecture and fled, Jue was at once appointed prefect and then transferred to Governor of Henan.

sentences.zh: 入為司農卿。

translations.literal: He entered the capital to serve as Minister of Agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the capital to serve as Minister of Agriculture.

sentences.zh: 是時，詔舉堪刺史、縣令者且百人，延問人間疾苦、吏得失，取尤通達者什二，宰相欲校以文詞，玨曰：「求良吏不可責文學，宜以上愛人之本為心也。」

translations.literal: At that time an edict recommended nearly a hundred men capable of serving as prefects and magistrates. They were summoned and questioned about the people's sufferings and officials' successes and failures, and the most thoroughly understanding were selected, one or two in ten. The chief ministers wished to test them with literary compositions. Jue said: "In seeking good officials one cannot demand literary learning; one ought to take the ruler's fundamental love of the people as the heart.
translations.idiomatic: At that time an edict recommended nearly a hundred men capable of serving as prefects and magistrates. They were summoned and questioned about the people's sufferings and officials' successes and failures, and the most thoroughly understanding were selected, one or two in ten. The chief ministers wished to test them with literary compositions. Jue said: "In seeking good officials one cannot demand literary learning; one ought to take the ruler's fundamental love of the people as the heart.

sentences.zh: 宰相多其計，所用皆稱職。

translations.literal: The chief ministers largely approved his plan, and those appointed all proved competent.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers largely approved his plan, and those appointed all proved competent.

sentences.zh: 為京兆尹，司農供三宮畜茹三十車，不足，請市京兆。

translations.literal: As Governor of Jingzhao, he found that the Ministry of Agriculture supplied thirty cartloads of livestock and vegetables for the three palaces, which was insufficient, and requested purchases from Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: As Governor of Jingzhao, he found that the Ministry of Agriculture supplied thirty cartloads of livestock and vegetables for the three palaces, which was insufficient, and requested purchases from Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 是時，韋彤為萬年令，玨使彤禁鬻賣，民苦之。

translations.literal: At that time Wei Tong was magistrate of Wannian. Jue had Tong prohibit sales, and the people suffered from this.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Wei Tong was magistrate of Wannian. Jue had Tong prohibit sales, and the people suffered from this.

sentences.zh: 德宗怒，奪玨、彤俸。

translations.literal: Emperor Dezong was angered and stripped Jue and Tong of their salaries.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Dezong was angered and stripped Jue and Tong of their salaries.

sentences.zh: 帝疑下情不達，因詔延英坐日許百司長官二員言闕失，謂之巡對。

translations.literal: The emperor suspected that conditions below were not reaching him and therefore issued an edict that on days of audience at Yanying Hall, two department heads from the hundred offices might speak of omissions and faults—this was called circuit remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor suspected that conditions below were not reaching him and therefore issued an edict that on days of audience at Yanying Hall, two department heads from the hundred offices might speak of omissions and faults—this was called circuit remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 玨剛嚴，曉法治，勤身以勸下，然苛察，無經術大體。

translations.literal: Jue was stern and strict, understood the laws, and worked diligently to encourage those below, yet he was harshly scrutinizing and lacked the broad principles of classical learning.
translations.idiomatic: Jue was stern and strict, understood the laws, and worked diligently to encourage those below, yet he was harshly scrutinizing and lacked the broad principles of classical learning.

sentences.zh: 坐善竇參，改太子賓客，出為嶺南觀察使。

translations.literal: Because he was friendly with Dou Can, he was transferred to Guest of the Crown Prince and sent out as Observation Commissioner of Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: Because he was friendly with Dou Can, he was transferred to Guest of the Crown Prince and sent out as Observation Commissioner of Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 卒，年七十四，贈工部尚書。

translations.literal: He died at the age of seventy-four and was posthumously appointed Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He died at the age of seventy-four and was posthumously appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 子存慶，字嗣德，貌偉岸。

translations.literal: His son Cunqing, styled Side, was imposing in appearance.
translations.idiomatic: His son Cunqing, courtesy name Side, was imposing in appearance.

sentences.zh: 及進士第，歷御史、尚書郎。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination and served through the posts of Censor and Director in the Ministries.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination and served through the posts of Censor and Director in the Ministries.

sentences.zh: 五遷給事中，與韋弘景封駁詔書，時稱其直。

translations.literal: After five promotions he became Supervising Secretary and, together with Wei Hongjing, sealed and returned edicts for revision. At the time he was praised for his uprightness.
translations.idiomatic: After five promotions he became Supervising Secretary and, together with Wei Hongjing, sealed and returned edicts for revision. At the time he was praised for his uprightness.

sentences.zh: 劉總以幽州歸，穆宗謂宰相曰：「必用薛存慶，可以宣朕意。」

translations.literal: When Liu Zong surrendered You Prefecture, Emperor Muzong said to the chief ministers: "Xue Cunqing must be used—he can proclaim my intent.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Zong surrendered You Prefecture, Emperor Muzong said to the chief ministers: "Xue Cunqing must be used—he can proclaim my intent.

sentences.zh: 對延英一刻，遣之，至鎮州，疽發於背卒，贈吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: After one quarter-hour of audience at Yanying Hall, he was dispatched. When he reached Zhen Prefecture, an abscess broke out on his back and he died. He was posthumously appointed Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: After one quarter-hour of audience at Yanying Hall, he was dispatched. When he reached Zhen Prefecture, an abscess broke out on his back and he died. He was posthumously appointed Vice Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 崔漢衡，博州博平人。

translations.literal: Cui Hanheng was a native of Boping in Bo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Hanheng was a native of Boping in Bo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 沈懿博厚，善與人交。

translations.literal: He was deep, generous, and kindly, and skilled at forming friendships.
translations.idiomatic: He was deep, generous, and kindly, and skilled at forming friendships.

sentences.zh: 始為費令，滑州節度使令狐彰表掌書記。

translations.literal: He first served as magistrate of Fei. Linghu Zhang, military commissioner of Hua Prefecture, memorialized that he serve as chief secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He first served as magistrate of Fei. Linghu Zhang, military commissioner of Hua Prefecture, memorialized that he serve as chief secretary.

sentences.zh: 大歷六年，以檢校禮部員外郎為和蕃副使。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Dali he served as Acting Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites as deputy envoy for peace with Tibet.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of the Dali reign he served as Acting Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites as deputy envoy for peace with Tibet.

sentences.zh: 還，遷右司郎中。

translations.literal: On his return he was transferred to Director of the Right Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was transferred to Director of the Right Bureau.

sentences.zh: 建中二年，吐蕃請盟，擢殿中少監，為和蕃使，與其使區頰贊俱來約盟。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianzhong, Tibet requested an alliance. He was promoted to Vice Director of the Palace Directorate and appointed envoy for peace with Tibet, coming together with the Tibetan envoy Qu Jiezan to arrange the alliance.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of the Jianzhong reign, Tibet requested an alliance. He was promoted to Vice Director of the Palace Directorate and appointed envoy for peace with Tibet, coming together with the Tibetan envoy Qu Jiezan to arrange the alliance.

sentences.zh: 改鴻臚卿，持節送區頰贊歸，遂定盟清水。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Director of the Court of State Ceremonial, bearing the imperial credential to escort Qu Jiezan home, and the alliance was then fixed at Qingshui.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Director of the Court of State Ceremonial, bearing the imperial credential to escort Qu Jiezan home, and the alliance was then fixed at Qingshui.

sentences.zh: 德宗幸奉天，吐蕃以兵佐渾瑊，敗賊武功。

translations.literal: When Emperor Dezong fled to Fengtian, Tibet sent troops to assist Hun Jian and defeated the rebels at Wugong.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Dezong fled to Fengtian, Tibet sent troops to assist Hun Jian and defeated the rebels at Wugong.

sentences.zh: 轉秘書監。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Director of the Palace Library.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Director of the Palace Library.

sentences.zh: 俄拜上都留守、兵部尚書、東都淄青魏博賑給宣慰使。

translations.literal: Soon he was appointed Defender of the Upper Capital, Minister of War, and Pacification and Relief Commissioner for the Ziqing and Weibo circuits of the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was appointed Defender of the Upper Capital, Minister of War, and Pacification and Relief Commissioner for the Ziqing and Weibo circuits of the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 又使幽州，還命稱指。

translations.literal: He was again sent to You Prefecture, and on his return his mission was deemed to have accorded with the imperial intent.
translations.idiomatic: He was again sent to You Prefecture, and on his return his mission was deemed to have accorded with the imperial intent.

sentences.zh: 貞元三年，豫吐蕃盟平涼，被執，虜將殺之，因夷言謂之曰：「我善結贊，無殺我！」

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhenyuan, at the alliance with Tibet at Pingliang, he was seized. The barbarians were about to kill him, and he therefore said to them in their language: "I am on good terms with Jiezan—do not kill me!
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Zhenyuan reign, at the alliance with Tibet at Pingliang, he was seized. The barbarians were about to kill him, and he therefore said to them in their language: "I am on good terms with Jiezan—do not kill me!

sentences.zh: 而漢衡誠信素著，虜亦尊重，故至河州得還。

translations.literal: Hanheng's sincerity and trustworthiness had long been renowned, and the barbarians also respected him, so when he reached He Prefecture he was able to return.
translations.idiomatic: Hanheng's sincerity and trustworthiness had long been renowned, and the barbarians also respected him, so when he reached He Prefecture he was able to return.

sentences.zh: 明年，出為晉慈隰觀察使，卒，贈尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: The next year he was sent out as Observation Commissioner of Jin, Ci, and Li and died. He was posthumously appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was sent out as Observation Commissioner of Jin, Ci, and Li and died. He was posthumously appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 戴叔倫，字幼公，潤州金壇人。

translations.literal: Dai Shulun, styled Yougong, was a native of Jintan in Run Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Shulun, courtesy name Yougong, was a native of Jintan in Run Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 師事蕭穎士，為門人冠。

translations.literal: He studied under Xiao Yingshi and was foremost among his disciples.
translations.idiomatic: He studied under Xiao Yingshi and was foremost among his disciples.

sentences.zh: 劉晏管鹽鐵，表主運湖南，至雲安，楊子琳反，馳客劫之曰：「歸我金幣，可緩死。」

translations.literal: Liu Yan managed the salt and iron monopolies and memorialized that Shulun oversee transport in Hunan. When he reached Yun'an, Yang Zilin rebelled. A mounted agent seized him and said: "Return my gold and coins and you may be spared death.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Yan managed the salt and iron monopolies and memorialized that Shulun oversee transport in Hunan. When he reached Yun'an, Yang Zilin rebelled. A mounted agent seized him and said: "Return my gold and coins and you may be spared death.

sentences.zh: 叔倫曰：「身可殺，財不可奪。」

translations.literal: Shulun said: "My person may be killed, but wealth cannot be seized.
translations.idiomatic: Shulun said: "My person may be killed, but wealth cannot be seized.

sentences.zh: 乃舍之。

translations.literal: They then released him.
translations.idiomatic: They then released him.

sentences.zh: 嗣曹王臯領湖南、江西，表在幕府。

translations.literal: Prince Si Cao Li Gao commanded Hunan and Jiangxi and memorialized that Shulun serve on his staff.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Si Cao Li Gao commanded Hunan and Jiangxi and memorialized that Shulun serve on his staff.

sentences.zh: 臯討李希烈，留叔倫領府事，試守撫州刺史。

translations.literal: When Gao campaigned against Li Xilie, he left Shulun in charge of headquarters affairs and tried him as acting prefect of Fu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When Gao campaigned against Li Xilie, he left Shulun in charge of headquarters affairs and tried him as acting prefect of Fu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 民歲爭溉灌，為作均水法，俗便利之。

translations.literal: Each year the people quarreled over irrigation. He devised a method for equalizing water distribution, and the custom found it convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Each year the people quarreled over irrigation. He devised a method for equalizing water distribution, and the custom found it convenient.

sentences.zh: 耕餉歲廣，獄無系囚。

translations.literal: Cultivation and tribute grain increased year by year, and the prisons held no bound prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: Cultivation and tribute grain increased year by year, and the prisons held no bound prisoners.

sentences.zh: 俄即真。

translations.literal: Soon his acting appointment was confirmed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon his acting appointment was confirmed.

sentences.zh: 期年，詔書褒美，封譙縣男，加金紫服。

translations.literal: After one full year an edict praised him. He was enfeoffed as Baron of Qiao County and granted the gold seal and purple robe.
translations.idiomatic: After one full year an edict praised him. He was enfeoffed as Baron of Qiao County and granted the gold seal and purple robe.

sentences.zh: 齊映、劉滋執政，叔倫勸以「屯難未靖，安之者莫先於兵，兵所藉者食，故金谷之司不輕易人。

translations.literal: When Qi Ying and Liu Zi held power, Shulun urged them: "The accumulated hardships are not yet settled. Of those who would settle them, none comes before the army, and what the army relies upon is food. Therefore the offices of finance and grain ought not lightly change personnel.
translations.idiomatic: When Qi Ying and Liu Zi held power, Shulun urged them: "The accumulated hardships are not yet settled. Of those who would settle them, none comes before the army, and what the army relies upon is food. Therefore the offices of finance and grain ought not lightly change personnel.

sentences.zh: 天下州縣有上、中、下，緊、望、雄、輔者，有司銓擬，皆便所私，此非為官擇人、為人求治之術。

translations.literal: Prefectures and counties throughout the realm are graded upper, middle, and lower, or tight, prominent, strong, and auxiliary. When the responsible offices make selections, they all favor their own private interests. This is not the method of choosing men for office and seeking good governance for the people.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures and counties throughout the realm are graded upper, middle, and lower, or tight, prominent, strong, and auxiliary. When the responsible offices make selections, they all favor their own private interests. This is not the method of choosing men for office and seeking good governance for the people.

sentences.zh: 其尤切者，縣令、錄事參軍事，此二者，宜出中書、門下，無計資序限，遠近高卑，一以殿最升降，則人知勸。」

translations.literal: Most urgently, the posts of magistrate and Recording Secretary—these two ought to be decided by the Secretariat and the Chancellery, without regard to seniority limits, distance, rank high or low. Let promotion and demotion depend entirely on assessment of merit, and then people will know encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: Most urgently, the posts of magistrate and Recording Secretary—these two ought to be decided by the Secretariat and the Chancellery, without regard to seniority limits, distance, rank high or low. Let promotion and demotion depend entirely on assessment of merit, and then people will know encouragement.

sentences.zh: 映等重其言。

translations.literal: Ying and the others valued his words.
translations.idiomatic: Ying and the others valued his words.

sentences.zh: 遷容管經略使，綏徠夷落，威名流聞。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Military Commissioner of Rongguan, pacifying and winning over the barbarian settlements. His authority and reputation spread far.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Military Commissioner of Rongguan, pacifying and winning over the barbarian settlements. His authority and reputation spread far.

sentences.zh: 其治清明仁恕，多方略，故所至稱最。

translations.literal: His governance was clear, bright, benevolent, and forgiving, and he had many stratagems. Therefore wherever he went he was called the best.
translations.idiomatic: His governance was clear, bright, benevolent, and forgiving, and he had many stratagems. Therefore wherever he went he was called the best.

sentences.zh: 德宗嘗賦《中和節詩》，遣使者寵賜。

translations.literal: Emperor Dezong once composed "Poem for the Zhonghe Festival" and sent an envoy to bestow it upon him as a mark of favor.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Dezong once composed "Poem for the Zhonghe Festival" and sent an envoy to bestow it upon him as a mark of favor.

sentences.zh: 代還，卒於道，年五十八。

translations.literal: When he was replaced and returned, he died on the road at the age of fifty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: When he was replaced and returned, he died on the road at the age of fifty-eight.

sentences.zh: 王翃，字宏肱，并州晉陽人。

translations.literal: Wang Hong, styled Honggong, was a native of Jinyang in Bing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Hong, courtesy name Honggong, was a native of Jinyang in Bing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 少治兵家。

translations.literal: In youth he studied military arts.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he studied military arts.

sentences.zh: 天寶中，授翃衛尉、羽林軍宿衛。

translations.literal: In the Tianbao era he was appointed to guard duty in the Ministry of the Guard and the Feathered Forest Army.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tianbao reign he was appointed to guard duty in the Ministry of the Guard and the Feathered Forest Army.

sentences.zh: 擢才兼文武科，出為辰州刺史。

translations.literal: He passed the examination for combined civil and military talent and was sent out as prefect of Chen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the examination for combined civil and military talent and was sent out as prefect of Chen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 與討襄州康楚元有功，加兼秘書少監，遷朗州刺史。

translations.literal: He had merit in the campaign against Kang Chuyuan of Xiang Prefecture, was additionally appointed Acting Vice Director of the Palace Library, and was transferred to prefect of Lang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He had merit in the campaign against Kang Chuyuan of Xiang Prefecture, was additionally appointed Acting Vice Director of the Palace Library, and was transferred to prefect of Lang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 大歷中，擢容管經略使。

translations.literal: In the Dali era he was promoted to Military Commissioner of Rongguan.
translations.idiomatic: During the Dali reign he was promoted to Military Commissioner of Rongguan.

sentences.zh: 初，安祿山亂，詔嶺南兵隸南陽魯炅。

translations.literal: At first, when An Lushan rebelled, an edict placed the troops of Lingnan under Lu Hui of Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when An Lushan rebelled, an edict placed the troops of Lingnan under Lu Hui of Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 炅敗績，眾奔潰。

translations.literal: Hui was defeated and the troops fled in rout.
translations.idiomatic: Hui was defeated and the troops fled in rout.

sentences.zh: 溪洞夷獠相挻為亂，夷酋梁崇牽號「平南都統」，與別帥覃問合，又與西原賊張侯、夏永更誘嘯，因陷城邑，遂據容州。

translations.literal: Barbarians and Liao tribesmen in stream valleys and caves stirred one another to rebellion in succession. The barbarian chieftain Liang Chongqian styled himself "Commander-in-Chief of Pacifying the South" and joined with the separate commander Tan Wen, then with the Xiyuan bandits Zhang Hou and Xia Yong to incite one another further. They thereupon captured cities and towns and seized Rong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Barbarians and Liao tribesmen in stream valleys and caves stirred one another to rebellion in succession. The barbarian chieftain Liang Chongqian styled himself "Commander-in-Chief of Pacifying the South" and joined with the separate commander Tan Wen, then with the Xiyuan bandits Zhang Hou and Xia Yong to incite one another further. They thereupon captured cities and towns and seized Rong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 前經略使陳仁琇、元結、長孫全緒等皆僑治藤、梧。

translations.literal: Former military commissioners Chen Renxiu, Yuan Jie, Changsun Quanxu, and others all governed in exile from Teng and Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Former military commissioners Chen Renxiu, Yuan Jie, Changsun Quanxu, and others all governed in exile from Teng and Wu.

sentences.zh: 翃至，言於眾曰：「我，容州刺史，安可客治它所？

translations.literal: When Hong arrived, he said to the assembly: "I am the prefect of Rong Prefecture—how can I govern in exile from elsewhere?
translations.idiomatic: When Hong arrived, he said to the assembly: "I am the prefect of Rong Prefecture—how can I govern in exile from elsewhere?

sentences.zh: 必得容乃止。」

translations.literal: I shall not stop until I recover Rong.
translations.idiomatic: I shall not stop until I recover Rong.

sentences.zh: 即出私財募士，有功者放署吏，於是人自奮。

translations.literal: He immediately spent his private wealth to recruit soldiers. Those with merit were provisionally appointed as clerks, and thereby each man exerted himself.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately spent his private wealth to recruit soldiers. Those with merit were provisionally appointed as clerks, and thereby each man exerted himself.

sentences.zh: 不數月，斬賊帥歐陽珪。

translations.literal: Within a few months he beheaded the bandit leader Ouyang Gui.
translations.idiomatic: Within a few months he beheaded the bandit leader Ouyang Gui.

sentences.zh: 因至廣州，請節度使李勉出兵並力，勉不許，曰：「容陷賊久，獠方強，今速攻，祗自敗耳。」

translations.literal: He then went to Guang Prefecture and requested that Military Commissioner Li Mian send troops to join forces. Mian did not consent and said: "Rong has long been lost to bandits and the Liao are still strong. If we attack quickly now, we will only defeat ourselves.
translations.idiomatic: He then went to Guang Prefecture and requested that Military Commissioner Li Mian send troops to join forces. Mian did not consent and said: "Rong has long been lost to bandits and the Liao are still strong. If we attack quickly now, we will only defeat ourselves.

sentences.zh: 翃曰：「大夫即不出師，願下書州縣，陽言以兵為助，冀藉此聲，成萬一功。」

translations.literal: Hong said: "Even if the grandee will not send troops, I beg that you issue letters to the prefectures and counties falsely stating that troops will assist, hoping by this reputation to achieve a one-in-ten-thousand success.
translations.idiomatic: Hong said: "Even if the grandee will not send troops, I beg that you issue letters to the prefectures and counties falsely stating that troops will assist, hoping by this reputation to achieve a one-in-ten-thousand success.

sentences.zh: 勉許諾。

translations.literal: Mian consented.
translations.idiomatic: Mian consented.

sentences.zh: 翃乃移書義、藤二州刺史，約皆進討，引兵三千與賊鏖戰，日數遇。

translations.literal: Hong then sent letters to the prefects of Yi and Teng Prefectures, arranging that all advance together in attack. He led three thousand troops to fight the bandits in fierce battle, encountering them several times a day.
translations.idiomatic: Hong then sent letters to the prefects of Yi and Teng Prefectures, arranging that all advance together in attack. He led three thousand troops to fight the bandits in fierce battle, encountering them several times a day.

sentences.zh: 勉檄止之，輒匿不發，戰愈力，卒破賊，禽崇牽，悉復容州故地。

translations.literal: Mian issued a dispatch ordering him to stop, but Hong concealed it and did not publish it. He fought all the harder, finally broke the bandits, captured Chongqian, and fully recovered the former territory of Rong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Mian issued a dispatch ordering him to stop, but Hong concealed it and did not publish it. He fought all the harder, finally broke the bandits, captured Chongqian, and fully recovered the former territory of Rong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 捷書聞，詔更置順州，以定餘亂。

translations.literal: When news of the victory arrived, an edict reestablished Shun Prefecture to settle the remaining disorder.
translations.idiomatic: When news of the victory arrived, an edict reestablished Shun Prefecture to settle the remaining disorder.

sentences.zh: 翃凡百餘戰，禽首領七十，覃問遁去。

translations.literal: Hong fought more than a hundred battles in all, captured seventy chieftains, and Tan Wen fled.
translations.idiomatic: In all Hong fought more than a hundred battles, captured seventy chieftains, and Tan Wen fled.

sentences.zh: 復遣將李寔等分討西原，平郁林等諸州。

translations.literal: He again dispatched the general Li Shi and others to campaign separately in Xiyuan and pacify the prefectures of Yulin and others.
translations.idiomatic: He again dispatched the general Li Shi and others to campaign separately in Xiyuan and pacify Yulin and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 累兼御史中丞、招討處置使。

translations.literal: He cumulatively served concurrently as Censor-in-Chief and Pacification and Disposition Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He cumulatively served concurrently as Censor-in-Chief and Pacification and Disposition Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 會哥舒晃反，翃命寔悉師援廣州，問因合眾乘間來襲，翃設伏擊之，生禽問，嶺表平。

translations.literal: When Geshu Huang rebelled, Hong ordered Shi to lead all troops to aid Guang Prefecture. Wen thereupon combined his forces and seized an opportunity to raid. Hong set an ambush and struck them, capturing Wen alive, and the region south of the mountains was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: When Geshu Huang rebelled, Hong ordered Shi to lead all troops to aid Guang Prefecture. Wen thereupon combined his forces and seized an opportunity to raid. Hong set an ambush and struck them, capturing Wen alive, and the region south of the mountains was pacified.

sentences.zh: 代宗遣使慰勞，加金紫光祿大夫，賜第京師。

translations.literal: Emperor Daizong sent an envoy to comfort and reward him, promoted him to Grand Master of the Gold Seal and Purple Robe, and granted him a residence in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Daizong sent an envoy to comfort and reward him, promoted him to Grand Master of the Gold Seal and Purple Robe, and granted him a residence in the capital.

sentences.zh: 時吐蕃入寇，郭子儀悉河中兵乘邊，召翃為河中少尹，領節度後務。

translations.literal: At that time Tibet invaded. Guo Ziyi deployed all the troops of Hezhong along the border and summoned Hong to serve as Vice Governor of Hezhong, overseeing rear headquarters affairs for the military commission.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Tibet invaded. Guo Ziyi deployed all the troops of Hezhong along the border and summoned Hong to serve as Vice Governor of Hezhong, overseeing rear headquarters affairs for the military commission.

sentences.zh: 悍將淩正數幹法不逞，約其徒夜斬關逐翃。

translations.literal: The fierce general Ling Zheng repeatedly violated the law without success and conspired with his followers to cut the pass gate by night and drive Hong out.
translations.idiomatic: The fierce general Ling Zheng repeatedly violated the law without success and conspired with his followers to cut the pass gate by night and drive Hong out.

sentences.zh: 翃覺之，陰亂漏刻，以差其期，眾驚，不敢發。

translations.literal: Hong detected this and secretly disrupted the water clock to alter the time, throwing the men into alarm so they dared not act.
translations.idiomatic: Hong detected this and secretly disrupted the water clock to alter the time, throwing the men into alarm so they dared not act.

sentences.zh: 俄禽正誅之，一軍惕息。

translations.literal: Soon he captured Zheng and executed him, and the whole army trembled into silence.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he captured Zheng and executed him, and the whole army trembled into silence.

sentences.zh: 歷汾州刺史，為振武軍使綏，銀等州留後。

translations.literal: He served successively as prefect of Fen Prefecture and as pacifying envoy of the Zhenwu Army and acting governor of Yin and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: He served successively as prefect of Fen Prefecture and as pacifying envoy of the Zhenwu Army and acting governor of Yin and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 入拜京兆尹。

translations.literal: He entered the capital and was appointed Governor of Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the capital and was appointed Governor of Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 會起涇原兵討李希烈，次浐水，京兆主供擬，饔敗肉腐，眾怒曰：「食是而討賊乎？」

translations.literal: Just then troops from Jingyuan were mobilized to campaign against Li Xilie. When they halted at Chan River, Jingzhao was responsible for provisions. The food was spoiled and the meat rotten, and the men angrily said: "Are we to eat this and campaign against bandits?
translations.idiomatic: Just then troops from Jingyuan were mobilized to campaign against Li Xilie. When they halted at Chan River, Jingzhao was responsible for provisions. The food was spoiled and the meat rotten, and the men angrily said: "Are we to eat this and campaign against bandits?

sentences.zh: 遂叛。

translations.literal: They then rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: They then rebelled.

sentences.zh: 翃挺身走奉天，拜太子詹事。

translations.literal: Hong ran alone to Fengtian and was appointed Mentor of the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: Hong ran alone to Fengtian and was appointed Mentor of the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 德宗還都，再遷大理卿，出為福建觀察使。

translations.literal: When Emperor Dezong returned to the capital, Hong was again transferred to Director of the Court of Judicial Review and sent out as Observation Commissioner of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Dezong returned to the capital, Hong was again transferred to Director of the Court of Judicial Review and sent out as Observation Commissioner of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 徙東都留守，既至，開田二十餘屯，脩器械，皆良金壽革，練士卒，號令精明。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Defender of the Eastern Capital. When he arrived, he opened more than twenty garrison fields and repaired weapons—all of fine metal and durable leather—and trained the soldiers, with commands clear and precise.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Defender of the Eastern Capital. When he arrived, he opened more than twenty garrison fields and repaired weapons—all of fine metal and durable leather—and trained the soldiers, with commands clear and precise.

sentences.zh: 俄而吳少誠叛，獨東畿為有備，關東賴之。

translations.literal: Before long Wu Shaocheng rebelled. Only the eastern capital region was prepared, and the east of the pass relied upon it.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Wu Shaocheng rebelled. Only the eastern capital region was prepared, and the east of the pass relied upon it.

sentences.zh: 貞元十八年卒，贈尚書右僕射，謚曰肅。

translations.literal: He died in the eighteenth year of Zhenyuan, was posthumously appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and was given the posthumous title Solemn.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the eighteenth year of the Zhenyuan reign, was posthumously appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and was given the posthumous title Solemn.

sentences.zh: 翃雅善盧杞，杞之殺崔寧、沮李懷光不得朝，皆與其謀，議者以為訾。

translations.literal: Hong was on intimate terms with Lu Qi. Qi's killing of Cui Ning and blocking Li Huai'guang from attending court were both plotted with him. Critics regarded this as a blemish.
translations.idiomatic: Hong was on intimate terms with Lu Qi. Qi's killing of Cui Ning and blocking Li Huai'guang from attending court were both plotted with him. Critics regarded this as a blemish.

sentences.zh: 子正雅，字光謙，行謹飭，為崔邠所器。

translations.literal: His son Zhengya, styled Guangqian, was careful and restrained in conduct and was admired by Cui Bin.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhengya, courtesy name Guangqian, was careful and restrained in conduct and was admired by Cui Bin.

sentences.zh: 元和初，擢進士，遷累監察御史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Yuanhe reign he passed the jinshi examination and was transferred through successive posts to Censor.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Yuanhe reign he passed the jinshi examination and rose through successive posts to Censor.

sentences.zh: 穆宗時，京邑多盜賊，正雅以萬年令威震豪強。

translations.literal: During the Muzong reign there were many bandits and robbers in the capital region. Zhengya, as magistrate of Wannian, awed the powerful.
translations.idiomatic: During the Muzong reign there were many bandits and robbers in the capital region. Zhengya, as magistrate of Wannian, awed the powerful.

sentences.zh: 尹柳公綽言其能，就賜緋魚，擢累汝州刺史。

translations.literal: Governor Liu Gongchuo spoke of his ability, and on the spot he was granted the crimson robe and fish tally and promoted through successive posts to prefect of Ru Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Liu Gongchuo spoke of his ability, and on the spot he was granted the crimson robe and fish tally and promoted through successive posts to prefect of Ru Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 屬監軍怙權，乃謝病去。

translations.literal: When the supervising eunuch relied on his power, Zhengya pleaded illness and resigned.
translations.idiomatic: When the supervising eunuch relied on his power, Zhengya pleaded illness and resigned.

sentences.zh: 入為大理卿，會爭宋申錫獄，堅甚，申錫得不死。

translations.literal: He entered the capital to serve as Director of the Court of Judicial Review. When the case of Song Shenxi was disputed, he stood firm, and Shenxi was spared death.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the capital to serve as Director of the Court of Judicial Review. When the case of Song Shenxi was disputed, he stood firm, and Shenxi was spared death.

sentences.zh: 大和中卒，贈左散騎常侍。

translations.literal: He died in the Dahe reign and was posthumously appointed Left Regular Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the Dahe reign and was posthumously appointed Left Regular Attendant.

sentences.zh: 翃兄翊，性謙柔，歷山南東道節度使。

translations.literal: Hong's elder brother Yi was gentle and modest by nature and served as military commissioner of Shannan East Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Hong's elder brother Yi was gentle and modest by nature and served as military commissioner of Shannan East Circuit.

sentences.zh: 代宗目為純臣，世稱謹廉。

translations.literal: Emperor Daizong regarded him as a pure minister, and the age praised his prudence and integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Daizong regarded him as a pure minister, and the age praised his prudence and integrity.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈戶部尚書，謚曰忠惠。

translations.literal: When he died he was posthumously appointed Minister of Revenue and given the posthumous title Loyal and Kind.
translations.idiomatic: When he died he was posthumously appointed Minister of Revenue and given the posthumous title Loyal and Kind.

sentences.zh: 翊曾孫凝，字成庶，少孤，依其舅宰相鄭肅。

translations.literal: Yi's great-grandson Ning, styled Chengsu, was orphaned in youth and relied upon his maternal uncle, Chief Minister Zheng Su.
translations.idiomatic: Yi's great-grandson Ning, courtesy name Chengsu, was orphaned in youth and relied upon his maternal uncle, Chief Minister Zheng Su.

sentences.zh: 舉明經、進士，皆中。

translations.literal: He passed both the mingjing and jinshi examinations.
translations.idiomatic: He passed both the mingjing and jinshi examinations.

sentences.zh: 歷臺省，浸知名，擢累禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: He served in the censorial and secretarial offices and gradually became known, rising through successive posts to Vice Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He served in the censorial and secretarial offices and gradually became known, rising through successive posts to Vice Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 不阿權近，出為商州刺史。

translations.literal: He did not flatter those in power nearby and was sent out as prefect of Shang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He did not flatter those in power nearby and was sent out as prefect of Shang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 驛道所出，吏破產不能給，而州有冶賦羨銀，常摧直以優吏奉。

translations.literal: The post road passed through the prefecture, and clerks were ruined trying to supply it. The prefecture had surplus silver from smelting taxes, which was regularly discounted to supplement clerks' salaries.
translations.idiomatic: The post road passed through the prefecture, and clerks were ruined trying to supply it. The prefecture had surplus silver from smelting taxes, which was regularly discounted to supplement clerks' salaries.

sentences.zh: 凝不取，則以市馬，故無橫擾，人皆慰悅。

translations.literal: Ning did not take it and instead used it to buy horses, so there was no arbitrary exaction and the people were all pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Ning did not take it and instead used it to buy horses, so there was no arbitrary exaction and the people were all pleased.

sentences.zh: 徙湖南觀察使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Observation Commissioner of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Observation Commissioner of Hunan.

sentences.zh: 僖宗立，召為兵部侍郎，領鹽鐵轉運使。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xizong ascended the throne, Ning was summoned to serve as Vice Minister of War and Commissioner of Salt and Iron Transport.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xizong ascended the throne, Ning was summoned to serve as Vice Minister of War and Commissioner of Salt and Iron Transport.

sentences.zh: 坐舉非其人，以秘書監分司東都，即拜河南尹。

translations.literal: Because he had recommended an unworthy man, he was made Director of the Palace Library with duties at the Eastern Capital, then immediately appointed Governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Because he had recommended an unworthy man, he was made Director of the Palace Library with duties at the Eastern Capital, then immediately appointed Governor of Henan.

sentences.zh: 遷宣歙池觀察使，時乾符四年也。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Observation Commissioner of Xuan, She, and Chi—it was the fourth year of Qianfu.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Observation Commissioner of Xuan, She, and Chi—it was the fourth year of Qianfu.

sentences.zh: 王仙芝之黨屠至德，勢益張，凝遣牙將孟琢助池守。

translations.literal: The band of Wang Xianzhi sacked Zhide and their power grew ever greater. Ning dispatched the guard officer Meng Zhuo to assist the prefect of Chi in defense.
translations.idiomatic: The band of Wang Xianzhi sacked Zhide and their power grew ever greater. Ning dispatched the guard officer Meng Zhuo to assist the prefect of Chi in defense.

sentences.zh: 賊益兵來攻，實欲襲南陵，凝遣樊儔以舟師扼青陽。

translations.literal: The bandits increased their forces to attack, intending in fact to raid Nanling. Ning dispatched Fan Chou with a naval force to block Qingyang.
translations.idiomatic: The bandits increased their forces to attack, intending in fact to raid Nanling. Ning dispatched Fan Chou with a naval force to block Qingyang.

sentences.zh: 儔違令，輕與賊戰，不勝，凝斬以徇，諸將聞，皆股栗，以死綴賊，賊不能進。

translations.literal: Chou disobeyed orders and lightly engaged the bandits but was defeated. Ning beheaded him as a warning, and when the generals heard this they all trembled in their thighs. They fought to the death to hold the bandits back, and the bandits could not advance.
translations.idiomatic: Chou disobeyed orders and lightly engaged the bandits but was defeated. Ning beheaded him as a warning, and when the generals heard this they all trembled in their thighs. They fought to the death to hold the bandits back, and the bandits could not advance.

sentences.zh: 時江南環境為盜區，凝以強弩據采石，張疑幟，遣別將馬穎解和州之圍。

translations.literal: At that time the Jiangnan region was surrounded by bandit territory. Ning held Caishi with strong crossbows and raised deceptive banners, and dispatched a separate general, Ma Ying, to relieve the siege of He Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Jiangnan region was surrounded by bandit territory. Ning held Caishi with strong crossbows and raised deceptive banners, and dispatched a separate general, Ma Ying, to relieve the siege of He Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 明年，賊大至，都將王涓自永陽赴敵，凝大宴，謂涓曰：「賊席勝而驕，可持重待之，慎毋戰。」

translations.literal: The next year the bandits arrived in great force. The commander Wang Juan set out from Yongyang to meet the enemy. Ning held a great feast and said to Juan: "The bandits are arrogant from victory and can be met with weighty patience. Be careful not to give battle.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the bandits arrived in great force. The commander Wang Juan set out from Yongyang to meet the enemy. Ning held a great feast and said to Juan: "The bandits are arrogant from victory and can be met with weighty patience. Be careful not to give battle.

sentences.zh: 涓意銳，日趨四舍，至南陵，未食即陣，死焉。

translations.literal: Juan was eager for glory and marched four leagues a day. When he reached Nanling he formed ranks without eating and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Juan was eager for glory and marched four leagues a day. When he reached Nanling he formed ranks without eating and died in battle.

sentences.zh: 監軍收餘卒數千，還走城，沮橈無去意，卒又恣橫不能禁，凝讓曰：「吏捕蝗者，不勝而仰食於民，則率暴以濟災也。

translations.literal: The supervising eunuch gathered the remaining several thousand soldiers, retreated toward the city, was discouraged and obstructive, and had no intention of leaving. The soldiers again ran wild and could not be restrained. Ning reproached him: "When officials catch locusts and fail, they live off the people—then they lead violence to worsen the disaster.
translations.idiomatic: The supervising eunuch gathered the remaining several thousand soldiers, retreated toward the city, was discouraged and obstructive, and had no intention of leaving. The soldiers again ran wild and could not be restrained. Ning reproached him: "When officials catch locusts and fail, they live off the people—then they lead violence to worsen the disaster.

sentences.zh: 今兵不能捍敵，又恣之犯民生業，何以稱朝廷待將軍意？」

translations.literal: Now the troops cannot repel the enemy yet are allowed to violate the people's livelihood—how does this accord with the court's intent in treating a general?
translations.idiomatic: Now the troops cannot repel the enemy yet are allowed to violate the people's livelihood—how does this accord with the court's intent in treating a general?

sentences.zh: 監軍詞屈，趣親吏入民舍奪馬，凝乘門望見，麾左右捕取殺之，由是不敢留，然益儲畜繕完以備賊，賊至不能加。

translations.literal: The supervising eunuch was speechless and urged his personal clerks to enter people's houses and seize horses. Ning watched from the gate, waved his attendants to seize and kill them, and thereafter they dared not remain. Yet he stored provisions and repaired defenses all the more to prepare against bandits, and when bandits came they could not harm him.
translations.idiomatic: The supervising eunuch was speechless and urged his personal clerks to enter people's houses and seize horses. Ning watched from the gate, waved his attendants to seize and kill them, and thereafter they dared not remain. Yet he stored provisions and repaired defenses all the more to prepare against bandits, and when bandits came they could not harm him.

sentences.zh: 會大星直寢庭墜，術家言宜上疾不視事以厭勝，凝曰：「東南，國有所出，而宣為大府，吾規脫禍可矣，顧一方何賴哉？

translations.literal: A great star fell straight into the courtyard of his residence. Diviners said he ought to feign illness and cease conducting affairs to overcome the omen. Ning said: "The southeast is where the state has its outlet, and Xuan is a great prefecture. I may plan to escape disaster myself—but upon what would the region rely?
translations.idiomatic: A great star fell straight into the courtyard of his residence. Diviners said he ought to feign illness and cease conducting affairs to overcome the omen. Ning said: "The southeast is where the state has its outlet, and Xuan is a great prefecture. I may plan to escape disaster myself—but upon what would the region rely?

sentences.zh: 誓與城相存亡，勿復言！」

translations.literal: I swear to live and die with the city—speak no more of this!
translations.idiomatic: I swear to live and die with the city—speak no more of this!

sentences.zh: 既而賊去。

translations.literal: Before long the bandits departed.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the bandits departed.

sentences.zh: 未幾，卒，年五十八，贈吏部尚書，謚曰貞。

translations.literal: Not long afterward he died at the age of fifty-eight, was posthumously appointed Minister of Personnel, and was given the posthumous title Upright.
translations.idiomatic: Not long afterward he died at the age of fifty-eight, was posthumously appointed Minister of Personnel, and was given the posthumous title Upright.

sentences.zh: 徐申，字維降，京兆人。

translations.literal: Xu Shen, styled Weijiang, was a native of Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Shen, courtesy name Weijiang, was a native of Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 擢進士第，累遷洪州長史。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination and was transferred through successive posts to Senior Administrator of Hong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination and rose through successive posts to Senior Administrator of Hong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 嗣曹王臯討李希烈，檄申以長史行刺史事，任職辦，臯表其能，遷韶州刺史。

translations.literal: Prince Si Cao Li Gao campaigned against Li Xilie and summoned Shen, as senior administrator, to act as prefect. He performed his duties capably, and Gao memorialized his ability and transferred him to prefect of Shao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Si Cao Li Gao campaigned against Li Xilie and summoned Shen, as senior administrator, to act as prefect. He performed his duties capably, and Gao memorialized his ability and transferred him to prefect of Shao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 韶自兵興四十年，刺史以縣為治署，而令丞雜處民閻。

translations.literal: Shao had been at war for forty years. Prefects used counties as their administrative seats, while magistrates and assistants were scattered among the people's lanes.
translations.idiomatic: Shao had been at war for forty years. Prefects used counties as their administrative seats, while magistrates and assistants were scattered among the people's lanes.

sentences.zh: 申按公田之廢者，募人假牛犁墾發，以所收半畀之，田久不治，故肥美，歲入凡三萬斛。

translations.literal: Shen surveyed abandoned public fields, recruited people to borrow oxen and plows for reclamation, and gave them half the harvest. The fields had long gone uncultivated and were therefore fertile, yielding thirty thousand hu per year.
translations.idiomatic: Shen surveyed abandoned public fields, recruited people to borrow oxen and plows for reclamation, and gave them half the harvest. The fields had long gone uncultivated and were therefore fertile, yielding thirty thousand hu per year.

sentences.zh: 諸工計所庸，受粟有差，乃徙治故州。

translations.literal: For the various craftsmen he calculated corvée owed and received grain in differing amounts, then moved the seat of government back to the old prefectural city.
translations.idiomatic: For the various craftsmen he calculated corvée owed and received grain in differing amounts, then moved the seat of government back to the old prefectural city.

sentences.zh: 未幾，邑闬如初。

translations.literal: Before long the lanes and wards were as they had been at first.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the lanes and wards were as they had been at first.

sentences.zh: 創驛候，作大市，器用皆具。

translations.literal: He established post stations and watch posts and built a great market—all implements and utensils were provided.
translations.idiomatic: He established post stations and watch posts and built a great market—all implements and utensils were provided.

sentences.zh: 州民詣觀察使，以其有功於人，請為生祠，申固讓，觀察使以狀聞，遷合州刺史。

translations.literal: The people of the prefecture went to the observation commissioner, saying that Shen had merit for the people, and requested a living shrine. Shen firmly declined. The observation commissioner reported this, and Shen was transferred to prefect of He Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the prefecture went to the observation commissioner, saying that Shen had merit for the people, and requested a living shrine. Shen firmly declined. The observation commissioner reported this, and Shen was transferred to prefect of He Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 始來韶，戶止七千，比六年，倍而半之。

translations.literal: When he first came to Shao there were only seven thousand households. Within six years the number doubled and increased by half again.
translations.idiomatic: When he first came to Shao there were only seven thousand households. Within six years the number doubled and increased by half again.

sentences.zh: 會初置景州，授刺史，賜錢五十萬，加節度副使。

translations.literal: When Jing Prefecture was first established, he was appointed its prefect, granted five hundred thousand cash, and additionally made Vice Military Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: When Jing Prefecture was first established, he was appointed its prefect, granted five hundred thousand cash, and additionally made Vice Military Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 遷邕管經略使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Military Commissioner of Yongguan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Military Commissioner of Yongguan.

sentences.zh: 黃洞納質供賦，不敢桀。

translations.literal: The Huang Cave tribes submitted hostages and paid tribute and dared not act arrogantly.
translations.idiomatic: The Huang Cave tribes submitted hostages and paid tribute and dared not act arrogantly.

sentences.zh: 逾年，進嶺南節度使。

translations.literal: After more than a year he was promoted to Military Commissioner of Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year he was promoted to Military Commissioner of Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 前使死，吏盜印，署府職百餘員，畏事泄，謀作亂。

translations.literal: The previous commissioner had died. Clerks stole the seal and signed more than a hundred headquarters appointments, fearing exposure and plotting rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: The previous commissioner had died. Clerks stole the seal and signed more than a hundred headquarters appointments, fearing exposure and plotting rebellion.

sentences.zh: 申覺，殺之，詿誤一不問。

translations.literal: Shen detected this, executed them, and questioned not a single person implicated by mistake.
translations.idiomatic: Shen detected this, executed them, and questioned not a single person implicated by mistake.

sentences.zh: 遠俗以攻劫相矜，申禁切，無復犯。

translations.literal: Remote customs took pride in raiding and plundering one another. Shen strictly forbade this, and there were no further violations.
translations.idiomatic: Remote customs took pride in raiding and plundering one another. Shen strictly forbade this, and there were no further violations.

sentences.zh: 外蕃歲以珠、玳瑁、香、文犀浮海至，申於常貢外，未嘗賸索，商賈饒盈。

translations.literal: Foreign tribes each year sent pearls, tortoiseshell, incense, and patterned rhinoceros horn by sea. Beyond the regular tribute Shen never made additional demands, and merchants grew rich.
translations.idiomatic: Foreign tribes each year sent pearls, tortoiseshell, incense, and patterned rhinoceros horn by sea. Beyond the regular tribute Shen never made additional demands, and merchants grew rich.

sentences.zh: 劉辟反，表請發卒五千，循馬援故道，繇爨蠻抵蜀，搗辟不備。

translations.literal: When Liu Pi rebelled, Shen memorialized requesting to dispatch five thousand soldiers along the old route of Ma Yuan, through the Cuan barbarians to reach Shu, and strike Pi where he was unprepared.
translations.idiomatic: When Liu Pi rebelled, Shen memorialized requesting to dispatch five thousand soldiers along the old route of Ma Yuan, through the Cuan barbarians to reach Shu, and strike Pi where he was unprepared.

sentences.zh: 詔可，加檢校禮部尚書，封東海郡公。

translations.literal: An edict approved this, and he was additionally appointed Acting Minister of Rites and enfeoffed as Duke of Donghai.
translations.idiomatic: An edict approved this, and he was additionally appointed Acting Minister of Rites and enfeoffed as Duke of Donghai.

sentences.zh: 詔未至，卒，年七十。

translations.literal: Before the edict arrived he died at the age of seventy.
translations.idiomatic: Before the edict arrived he died at the age of seventy.

sentences.zh: 贈太子少保，謚曰平。

translations.literal: He was posthumously appointed Junior Preceptor of the Crown Prince and given the posthumous title Peaceful.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously appointed Junior Preceptor of the Crown Prince and given the posthumous title Peaceful.

sentences.zh: 郗士美，字和夫，兗州金鄉人。

translations.literal: Xi Shimei, styled Hefu, was a native of Jinxiang in Yan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Shimei, courtesy name Hefu, was a native of Jinxiang in Yan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 父純，字高卿，舉進士、拔萃、制策皆高第，張九齡、李邕數稱之。

translations.literal: His father Chun, styled Gaoging, passed the jinshi, exceptional promotion, and decree examinations all with high ranks. Zhang Jiuling and Li Yong repeatedly praised him.
translations.idiomatic: His father Chun, courtesy name Gaoging, passed the jinshi, exceptional promotion, and decree examinations all with high ranks. Zhang Jiuling and Li Yong repeatedly praised him.

sentences.zh: 自拾遺七遷至中書舍人。

translations.literal: From Left Reminder he was transferred through seven promotions to Drafting Secretary of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: From Left Reminder he rose through seven promotions to Drafting Secretary of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 處事不回，為宰相元載所忌。

translations.literal: In handling affairs he would not bend, and Chief Minister Yuan Zai resented him.
translations.idiomatic: In handling affairs he would not bend, and Chief Minister Yuan Zai resented him.

sentences.zh: 時魚朝恩以牙將李琮署兩街功德使，琮恃勢桀橫，眾辱京兆尹崔昭於禁中，純曰：「此國恥也。」

translations.literal: At that time Yu Chaoen, through the guard officer Li Cong, appointed Cong superintendent of the two wards' merit offices. Cong relied on power and acted arrogantly, publicly humiliating Governor of Jingzhao Cui Zhao in the palace. Chun said: "This is a national disgrace.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Yu Chaoen, through the guard officer Li Cong, appointed Cong superintendent of the two wards' merit offices. Cong relied on power and acted arrogantly, publicly humiliating Governor of Jingzhao Cui Zhao in the palace. Chun said: "This is a national disgrace.

sentences.zh: 即詣載請速處其罪，載不納，遂辭疾還東都，號「伊川田父」，十年不出。

translations.literal: He immediately went to Zai and requested that the crime be swiftly punished. Zai did not accept this, so Chun pleaded illness and returned to the eastern capital, styling himself "Father of the Fields of the Yi River," and for ten years did not go out.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately went to Zai and requested that the crime be swiftly punished. Zai did not accept this, so Chun pleaded illness and returned to the eastern capital, styling himself "Father of the Fields of the Yi River," and for ten years did not go out.

sentences.zh: 德宗立，崔祐甫輔政，召為太子左庶子、集賢殿學士，不拜，以老乞身。

translations.literal: When Emperor Dezong ascended the throne, Cui Youfu assisted in government and summoned Chun as Junior Mentor of the Left and Academician of the Hall of Collected Treasures, but he did not accept and begged to retire on account of age.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Dezong ascended the throne, Cui Youfu assisted in government and summoned Chun as Junior Mentor of the Left and Academician of the Hall of Collected Treasures, but he did not accept and begged to retire on account of age.

sentences.zh: 改詹事，聽致仕。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Mentor and permitted to retire.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Mentor and permitted to retire.

sentences.zh: 帝召見，褒嘆良久，賜金紫，公卿以下鹹祖都門，世高其節。

translations.literal: The emperor summoned him for an audience, praised and sighed over him for a long time, granted him the gold seal and purple robe, and from grandees down all escorted him to the capital gate—his integrity was held in high esteem by the age.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor summoned him for an audience, praised and sighed over him for a long time, granted him the gold seal and purple robe, and from grandees down all escorted him to the capital gate—his integrity was held in high esteem by the age.

sentences.zh: 士美年十二，通《五經》、《史記》、《漢書》，皆能成誦。

translations.literal: At the age of twelve Shimei mastered the Five Classics, the Records of the Grand Historian, and the Book of Han, all of which he could recite from memory.
translations.idiomatic: At the age of twelve Shimei mastered the Five Classics, the Records of the Grand Historian, and the Book of Han, all of which he could recite from memory.

sentences.zh: 父友蕭穎士、顏真卿、柳芳與相論繹，嘗曰：「吾曹異日當交二郗之間矣。」

translations.literal: His father's friends Xiao Yingshi, Yan Zhenqing, and Liu Fang discussed learning with one another and once said: "We shall one day associate with the two Xi.
translations.idiomatic: His father's friends Xiao Yingshi, Yan Zhenqing, and Liu Fang discussed learning with one another and once said: "We shall one day associate with the two Xi.

sentences.zh: 未冠為陽翟丞，佐李抱真潞州幕府。

translations.literal: Before reaching adulthood cap he served as assistant magistrate of Yangzhai and aided Li Baozhen's staff in Lu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Before reaching adulthood he served as assistant magistrate of Yangzhai and aided Li Baozhen's staff in Lu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以才，歷王虔休、李元，皆留不徙。

translations.literal: For his talent he served under Wang Qianxiu and Li Yuan, and both kept him without transferring him.
translations.idiomatic: For his talent he served under Wang Qianxiu and Li Yuan, and both kept him without transferring him.

sentences.zh: 久乃進房州刺史、黔中經略觀察使。

translations.literal: After a long time he was promoted to prefect of Fang Prefecture and Military Commissioner and Observation Commissioner of Qianzhong.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time he was promoted to prefect of Fang Prefecture and Military Commissioner and Observation Commissioner of Qianzhong.

sentences.zh: 溪州賊向子琪以眾八千岨山剽劫，士美討平之，加檢校右散騎常侍，封高平郡公。

translations.literal: The bandit of Xi Prefecture, Xiang Ziqi, with eight thousand men plundered from steep mountain positions. Shimei suppressed and pacified him, was additionally appointed Acting Right Regular Attendant, and was enfeoffed as Duke of Gaoping.
translations.idiomatic: The bandit of Xi Prefecture, Xiang Ziqi, with eight thousand men plundered from steep mountain positions. Shimei suppressed and pacified him, was additionally appointed Acting Right Regular Attendant, and was enfeoffed as Duke of Gaoping.

sentences.zh: 遷京兆尹，天子多所咨逮。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Governor of Jingzhao, and the Son of Heaven frequently consulted him.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Governor of Jingzhao, and the emperor frequently consulted him.

sentences.zh: 出為鄂嶽觀察使。

translations.literal: He was sent out as Observation Commissioner of E and Yue.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as Observation Commissioner of E and Yue.

sentences.zh: 時安黃節度使伊慎入朝，其子宥主後務，偃蹇，母死京師不發喪，欲固其權。

translations.literal: At that time Military Commissioner of An and Huang Yin Shen was attending court. His son You managed rear affairs and acted arrogantly. When his mother died in the capital he did not begin mourning, wishing to consolidate his power.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Military Commissioner of An and Huang Yin Shen was attending court. His son You managed rear affairs and acted arrogantly. When his mother died in the capital he did not begin mourning, wishing to consolidate his power.

sentences.zh: 士美知之，使府屬過其境，宥出迎，因以母訃告之，即為辦裝，宥惶遽上道。

translations.literal: Shimei learned of this and had a headquarters officer pass through You's territory. You came out to welcome him, and Shimei thereby informed him of his mother's death. You immediately prepared his baggage and hurried on his way in alarm.
translations.idiomatic: Shimei learned of this and had a headquarters officer pass through You's territory. You came out to welcome him, and Shimei thereby informed him of his mother's death. You immediately prepared his baggage and hurried on his way in alarm.

sentences.zh: 改河南尹，檢校工部尚書，充昭義節度使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Governor of Henan, Acting Minister of Works, and Military Commissioner of Zhaoyi.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Governor of Henan, Acting Minister of Works, and Military Commissioner of Zhaoyi.

sentences.zh: 昭義自李抱真以來皆武臣，私廚月費米六千石、羊千首、酒數十斛，潞人困甚。

translations.literal: Since Li Baozhen, Zhaoyi had been held by military men. Private kitchens monthly consumed six thousand shi of rice, a thousand sheep, and dozens of hu of wine—the people of Lu were greatly distressed.
translations.idiomatic: Since Li Baozhen, Zhaoyi had been held by military men. Private kitchens monthly consumed six thousand shi of rice, a thousand sheep, and dozens of hu of wine—the people of Lu were greatly distressed.

sentences.zh: 士美至，悉去之，出稟錢市物自給。

translations.literal: When Shimei arrived he abolished all of this and used his salary money to buy provisions for himself.
translations.idiomatic: When Shimei arrived he abolished all of this and used his salary money to buy provisions for himself.

sentences.zh: 又盧從史時，日具三百人膳以餉牙兵，士美曰：「卒衛於牙，固職也，安得廣費為私恩？」

translations.literal: Under Lu Congshi as well, three hundred men's meals were daily prepared to feed the guard soldiers. Shimei said: "Soldiers guarding headquarters are performing their duty—how can broad expense be made private favor?
translations.idiomatic: Under Lu Congshi as well, three hundred men's meals were daily prepared to feed the guard soldiers. Shimei said: "Soldiers guarding headquarters are performing their duty—how can broad expense be made private favor?

sentences.zh: 亦罷之。

translations.literal: He abolished this as well.
translations.idiomatic: He abolished this as well.

sentences.zh: 討王承宗也，遣大將王獻督萬人為前鋒，獻恣橫逗橈，士美即斬以徇，下令曰：「敢後者斬！」

translations.literal: In the campaign against Wang Chengzong he dispatched the great general Wang Xian to command ten thousand men as vanguard. Xian acted arrogantly and delayed and obstructed. Shimei immediately beheaded him as a warning and issued an order: "Whoever falls behind will be beheaded!
translations.idiomatic: In the campaign against Wang Chengzong he dispatched the great general Wang Xian to command ten thousand men as vanguard. Xian acted arrogantly and delayed and obstructed. Shimei immediately beheaded him as a warning and issued an order: "Whoever falls behind will be beheaded!

sentences.zh: 親鼓之，大破賊，下三營環柏鄉。

translations.literal: He personally beat the drums for them, routed the bandits on a great scale, and captured three camps encircling Baixiang.
translations.idiomatic: He personally beat the drums for them, routed the bandits on a great scale, and captured three camps encircling Baixiang.

sentences.zh: 時諸鎮兵合十餘萬繞賊，多玩寇犯法，獨士美兵銳整，最先有功。

translations.literal: At that time the troops of the various circuits totaled more than a hundred thousand surrounding the bandits. Most treated the enemy lightly and violated the law, but Shimei's army alone was sharp and orderly and achieved merit first.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the troops of the various circuits totaled more than a hundred thousand surrounding the bandits. Most treated the enemy lightly and violated the law, but Shimei's army alone was sharp and orderly and achieved merit first.

sentences.zh: 憲宗喜曰：「固知士美能辦吾事。」

translations.literal: Emperor Xianzong said with pleasure: "I knew all along that Shimei could accomplish my task.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xianzong said with pleasure: "I knew all along that Shimei could accomplish my task.

sentences.zh: 承宗大震懼。

translations.literal: Chengzong was greatly shaken with fear.
translations.idiomatic: Chengzong was greatly shaken with fear.

sentences.zh: 亡幾，會詔班師，然威震兩河。

translations.literal: Before long an edict ordered withdrawal of the army, yet his authority shook both Hebei and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Before long an edict ordered withdrawal of the army, yet his authority shook both Hebei and Henan.

sentences.zh: 以疾召拜工部尚書。

translations.literal: Because of illness he was summoned and appointed Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Because of illness he was summoned and appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 後檢校刑部尚書，為忠武節度使。

translations.literal: Later he was appointed Acting Minister of Justice and Military Commissioner of Zhongwu.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was appointed Acting Minister of Justice and Military Commissioner of Zhongwu.

sentences.zh: 卒，年六十四，贈尚書左僕射，謚曰景。

translations.literal: He died at the age of sixty-four, was posthumously appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and was given the posthumous title Illustrious.
translations.idiomatic: He died at the age of sixty-four, was posthumously appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs, and was given the posthumous title Illustrious.

sentences.zh: 生平與人交，已然諾，以是名重於世。

translations.literal: Throughout his life in associating with others, once he gave his word he kept it, and for this his name was weighty in the world.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout his life in associating with others, once he gave his word he kept it, and for this his reputation was weighty in the world.

sentences.zh: 辛秘，系出隴西。

translations.literal: Xin Mi traced his lineage to Longxi.
translations.idiomatic: Xin Mi traced his lineage to Longxi.

sentences.zh: 貞元中，擢明經第，授華原主簿。

translations.literal: In the Zhenyuan era he passed the mingjing examination and was appointed chief clerk of Huayuan.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhenyuan reign he passed the mingjing examination and was appointed chief clerk of Huayuan.

sentences.zh: 以判入等，調長安尉。

translations.literal: Because his judicial decisions were graded in the top rank, he was transferred to assistant magistrate of Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Because his judicial decisions were graded in the top rank, he was transferred to assistant magistrate of Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 其學於禮家尤洽，高郢為太常卿，奏為博士。

translations.literal: His learning in the school of ritual was especially thorough. When Gao Ying served as Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, he memorialized that Mi be appointed Erudite.
translations.idiomatic: His learning in the school of ritual was especially thorough. When Gao Ying served as Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, he memorialized that Mi be appointed Erudite.

sentences.zh: 再遷兵部員外郎，常兼博士。

translations.literal: He was again transferred to Vice Director of the Ministry of War and regularly served concurrently as Erudite.
translations.idiomatic: He was again transferred to Vice Director of the Ministry of War and regularly served concurrently as Erudite.

sentences.zh: 再辟禮儀使府。

translations.literal: He was again recruited to the headquarters of the Commissioner of Rites and Ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: He was again recruited to the headquarters of the Commissioner of Rites and Ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 憲宗初，拜湖州刺史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xianzong's reign he was appointed prefect of Hu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Emperor Xianzong's reign he was appointed prefect of Hu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 李锜反，遣大將先取支州。

translations.literal: When Li Qi rebelled, he dispatched a great general to seize Zhi Prefecture first.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Qi rebelled, he dispatched a great general to seize Zhi Prefecture first.

sentences.zh: 蘇、常、杭、睦四刺史，或戰敗，或拘脅，獨秘以儒者，賊易之。

translations.literal: The four prefects of Su, Chang, Hang, and Mu were either defeated in battle or coerced into submission. Mi alone was a Confucian scholar, and the bandits underestimated him.
translations.idiomatic: The four prefects of Su, Chang, Hang, and Mu were either defeated in battle or coerced into submission. Mi alone was a Confucian scholar, and the bandits underestimated him.

sentences.zh: 未及至，秘召牙將丘知二夜開城收壯士，得數百，逆賊大戰，斬其將，進焚營保。

translations.literal: Before they arrived, Mi summoned the guard officer Qiu Zhier, who opened the city by night and gathered stalwart men, obtaining several hundred. They fought the bandits in great battle, beheaded their general, and advanced to burn their fortified camps.
translations.idiomatic: Before they arrived, Mi summoned the guard officer Qiu Zhier, who opened the city by night and gathered stalwart men, obtaining several hundred. They fought the bandits in great battle, beheaded their general, and advanced to burn their fortified camps.

sentences.zh: 锜平，賜金紫。

translations.literal: When Qi was pacified, Mi was granted the gold seal and purple robe.
translations.idiomatic: When Qi was pacified, Mi was granted the gold seal and purple robe.

sentences.zh: 僉謂秘材任將帥，會河東範希朝出討王承宗，召秘為希朝司馬，主留務。

translations.literal: All agreed that Mi had the talent to serve as a general. When Fan Xichao of Hedong set out to campaign against Wang Chengzong, Mi was summoned to serve as Xichao's vice commander in charge of remaining headquarters affairs.
translations.idiomatic: All agreed that Mi had the talent to serve as a general. When Fan Xichao of Hedong set out to campaign against Wang Chengzong, Mi was summoned to serve as Xichao's vice commander in charge of remaining headquarters affairs.

sentences.zh: 累遷汝、常州刺史，河南尹，進拜昭義軍節度使。

translations.literal: He was transferred through successive posts to prefect of Ru and Chang Prefectures and Governor of Henan, then promoted to Military Commissioner of the Zhaoyi Army.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive posts to prefect of Ru and Chang Prefectures and Governor of Henan, then was promoted to Military Commissioner of the Zhaoyi Army.

sentences.zh: 是時，承討恒、趙之後，潞人雕耗。

translations.literal: At that time, after the campaign against Heng and Zhao, the people of Lu were exhausted and depleted.
translations.idiomatic: At that time, after the campaign against Heng and Zhao, the people of Lu were exhausted and depleted.

sentences.zh: 秘至，則約出入，嗇用度，比四年，儲錢十七萬緡、糧七十萬斛，器械堅良，隱然復為完鎮。

translations.literal: When Mi arrived, he restricted comings and goings and was sparing in expenditures. Within four years he had stored 170,000 strings of cash and 700,000 hu of grain. Weapons were solid and fine, and the circuit quietly became a complete garrison again.
translations.idiomatic: When Mi arrived, he restricted comings and goings and was sparing in expenditures. Within four years he had stored 170,000 strings of cash and 700,000 hu of grain. Weapons were solid and fine, and the circuit quietly became a complete garrison again.

sentences.zh: 召還，道病卒，年六十四，贈尚書左僕射，謚曰肅，後更謚懿。

translations.literal: He was recalled, fell ill on the road, and died at the age of sixty-four. He was posthumously appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and given the posthumous title Solemn; later it was changed to Worthy.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled, fell ill on the road, and died at the age of sixty-four. He was posthumously appointed Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and given the posthumous title Solemn; later it was changed to Worthy.

sentences.zh: 秘為大官，居不易第，服不改初，其奉祿悉與裏表親屬。

translations.literal: Mi held high office yet did not change his residence, nor alter the clothes he had worn at first. His salary he gave entirely to relatives within and beyond the neighborhood.
translations.idiomatic: Mi held high office yet did not change his residence, nor alter the clothes he had worn at first. His salary he gave entirely to relatives within and beyond the neighborhood.

sentences.zh: 病，自銘其墓，作書一通緘之。

translations.literal: When ill, he himself inscribed his tomb and wrote one letter, which he sealed.
translations.idiomatic: When ill, he himself inscribed his tomb and wrote one letter, which he sealed.

sentences.zh: 卒後發視，則送終制也，儉而不違於禮雲。

translations.literal: After his death it was opened and examined—it contained instructions for his funeral, frugal yet not violating ritual, and so forth.
translations.idiomatic: After his death it was opened and examined—it contained instructions for his funeral, frugal yet not violating ritual, and so forth.
